articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis on Phenomena of Counterfeit Commodity
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Analyzing the selecting action of strategy in interaction between the enterprises and the consumers and government in market with the evolutionary game theory: using duplicative dynamic studied the phenomenon of counterfeit commodity, according to the analysis of evolutionary game model, through long-term repeated game, learning and imitation, obtained the relevant evolutionary stable strategy. The result shows that if the income for producing counterfeit commodity of enterprises is larger than the income for producing normal commodity, or the supervising cost of government is too high, the counterfeit commodity emerge inevitably; enforcing the punishment for producing the counterfeit commodity of enterprises strictly, containing motive of producing counterfeit commodity of enterprises, enhancing income level of low-income groups, eliminating demand market of counterfeit commodity, are all the important ways to eliminate counterfeit commodity.

articleTitle: The Method of Exact Division for BA and ABA
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The paper give the method for exact division and common factor extraction in bracket algebra. It consists of two part. The first part is exact division for single bracket. Here, a theory will be given. The second part is about exact division about monomial. We still give a theory. Based on them, the paper gives exact division about general bracket polynomials. Finally, a practical comparing result is list which show out the importance of introducing exact division theory.

articleTitle: Image Data Acquisition and Transmission System Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Image acquisition and transmission is indispensable component in monitoring system and many entertainment devices. An image data collection and transmission system based on ARM (advanced RISC machines) is presented in this paper. The hardware architecture of the system is designed, ARM9 core S3C2410 chip was used as the kernel control unit of this system, USB interface mode is used to connect the camera exteriorly, and network transmission adopts UDP mode. Image capture process and image data transmission is studied, the UDP datagram program is designed, and the software implementation of system is given. The test results show that the system is feasible and effective and it can be used widely in various monitoring systems and entertainment devices.

articleTitle: Brand Virtual Management
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this multimedia, multi-channel, multi-sensory digital age, the emergence and popularization of Internet has created the condition for the brands' entering from the real world to the virtual world. Along with the unceasing enhancement of Internet, brand virtual management will be more and more popular.

articleTitle: Study on Algorithm of Intelligent Test Paper
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The requirements of the test paper are analyzed in details. The mathematical model of intelligent test paper generation system is set up. The method of test paper auto-generation based on general discrete particle swarm optimization is proposed.

articleTitle: Discussion on Minimizing File Access Privilege
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Least privilege is a basic principle to be conformed to when design computer systems. For file access control, the paper decomposes least privilege as user least privilege and program least privilege. User least privilege is a set of file with the corresponding access mode with which the user can access the file, and program least privilege is a set of file with the corresponding access mode with which the program can access the file. The paper discusses security properties of program least privilege in detail, and points out that the security risk of system is dynamic, and the user must be responsible for security, because that user's operations affect risk of system directly. Once a system satisfies program least privilege, it will be immune against most file attacks. Further more, granularity of privilege and security limitations are discussed, which are relevant to program least privilege.

articleTitle: Blind Speech Separation Based on Homotopy Non-linear Model
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Blind source extraction (BSE) algorithm based on linear prediction model can be used to separate speech signals. The best advantage of this algorithm is that it is very simple and easy to compute. This algorithm is based on the fact that speech signals can be modeled by linear prediction process. But homotopy non-linear model is better than linear prediction model for speech signals. A new BSE algorithm based on homotopy non-linear model is proposed to separate speech signals. Computer simulations show that the proposed algorithm has better performance than the BSE algorithm based on linear prediction model.

articleTitle: Study on Extracting the Colors of Road Network Based on the Highway Traffic Map Images
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In recent years, with the aid of computer technology, geographical information system (GIS), which has the ability to handle a large amount of geographical data in it. In particular, substantial efforts are devoted to the conversion of paper-based map into computer readable from which is suitable for input into GIS. This paper puts forward a novel algorithm, which may extract efficaciously the colors of the road network from paper-based highway map images. This algorithm includes several key steps. Firstly, according to the features of the non-road regions, the luminance of the non-road regions is extracted. Secondly, based on the color and shape features, the gray-scale morphology's dilation operator and a median filter are applied to eliminate some thin and small objects of the map image. Finally, taking advantage of some digital image processing technologies such as connection component and thinning algorithm, the colors of the road network are recognized and extract accurately. This algorithm has been applied to many highway traffic map images. It is shown that the algorithm is effective in various cases successfully.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Handling Stability for Forest Fire Patrolling Vehicle Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Front suspension system's dynamics behaviors simulation model for a forest fire patrolling vehicle was built by using ADAMS/Car in order to evaluate handling stability of the vehicle. The wheel parameters of the vehicle which affect vehicle's handling performances were simulated and analyzed. The relationship between the wheel parameters, such as the camber angle, toe-in angle, kingpin inclination angle as well as caster angle, and the wheel travel distance in vertical direction has been investigated. The front suspension location parameters are able to guarantee that the vehicle has under-steering characteristic and aligning performance.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation on TinySec Rekeying for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Two neural network-based models can synchronize its initially different weight vectors by limited steps of single output bit-based mutual learning if only the two models hold a common input space. Such novel weight synchronization property can well be used for secure key exchange over a public communication channel. Itpsilas more suitable for the resource-constraint sensor networks because that the full weight synchronization model can be easily implemented with low consuming of both computing and communication. At current, as for wireless sensor networks, TinySec is a popular deployed protocol for data link security. However, there is no key management solution designed for TinySec protocol, such as shared key distribution and update. In this paper, a lightweight key update scheme for TinySec is proposed based on the weight synchronization model. The implementations, as well as simulation tests, for the proposed scheme are all discussed.

articleTitle: Development Model of Email Virus Based on Abnormity Detection
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Computer viruses and worms pose serious threats to the modern society by stealing the confidential information, modifying files and destroying the operating system. Especially, the email has become the primary measure to spreading viruses. Inspired on the classical epidemiological model, an improving model based on the dynamic infected rate and immune rate is proposed. The simulation experiments are carried out by altering the correlative parameters and the experimental results provide the clue for developing the detected scheme of email virus. A promising detected scheme is proposed which detected viruses based on the abnormal behaviors of viral emails rather than the pattern of viruses. This scheme can throttle the new viruses and accords with the developing requirement of anti-virus technology.

articleTitle: The Calibration Technique for Pipelined ADC
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The calibration technique of pipelined ADCs has developed many years. This paper reviews the history of calibration technique and introduces some typical calibration approaches. According to the status of calibration technique, this paper predicts some possible direction of the future work.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Communication to Mine Micro Seismic Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of remote and high-speed data transmission, a remote communication system based on the analysis of existing communications facilities in mine, by using transmission network composed of PABX and Internet transfer controls programming, establish a link between mine micro seismic monitoring system and computer control center on the ground. And a special problem about real-time data transmission of MIS is resolved. This simple and reliable method can be also applied to remote control mine micro seismic monitor.

articleTitle: Establishing Electonic Collaboration in Order Decomposition for Virtual Manufacturing Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Business to business e-commerce is developing rapidly in China. However the collaboration is normally done manually. As a result, the information exchange is not timely and the collaboration is not as efficient as expected. On the basis of the order decomposition analysis in virtual manufacturing enterprise, an electronic collaboration mechanism is proposed and a related platform is introduced to enable such collaboration. The architecture of this platform is presented and the prototype is demonstrated.

articleTitle: An Audition Model Based on Content Service on Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Validity of content service on ad hoc networks is significantly affected by the QoS of network and quality of service content. Many current models of content service resolve mainly service selecting and accessing. However, many duplicate services in a heterogeneous environment have often been polluted before service published. Our work proposes an audition model to ensure availability of service content. Simulation results reveal that the model can improve availability of service content and validity of content service.

articleTitle: Research of Policy-Based Network Management Based on MA
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: PBNM technology and MA technology are the newly developing subjects in network management field. These two network management methods have advantages and disadvantages for each. This article puts forward a new network management method-PBNMBMA, and introduces a multi-domain management procedure and the function of each module in detail. PBNMBMA should be a more effective method in network management.

articleTitle: To Evaluate the System of Equipment Repairing and Maintenance Based on WAA Algorithm and CWAA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The system of equipment repairing and maintenance is one system that consists of all kinds of factors. The evaluation of this system's function and efficiency is the result of many professors' efforts. The application of WAA algorithm and CWAA algorithm can solve multi-attribute questions of evaluation, and order the program to choose the best one.

Author Keywords: the system of equipment repairing and maintenance

articleTitle: Immune Model-Based Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent methodology for diagnosing incipient faults. In this fault diagnosis system, in order to enhance the immune algorithms performance, we propose the improved immune-based symbiotic a new evolutionary learning algorithm. This new evolutionary learning algorithm is based on a particle swarm optimization (PSO) technique to improve the mutation mechanism. The application of real-valued negative selection algorithms to simulated and real-world systems is considered. These algorithms deal with the self-nonself discrimination problem in immunity computing, where normal process behaviour is coded as the self and any deviations from normal behaviour is encoded as nonself. The performance of the proposed method is demonstrated using simulation data and compared with other methods. The classification results showed that the proposed method outperforms traditional PSO-based method.

articleTitle: Forecasting Mechanism for Wireless Network Packet Transmission
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This research proposed an effective mechanism for an effective solution to tackle missing data problem in the handoff delay. The focus of this research is the effective combination of multicast-base and forecast enhancement prediction mechanism. This solution will help future network management for bandwidth reservation for mobile users in motion.

articleTitle: Locally Optimum Detection of a Noise Model Based on Generalized Gaussian Distribution
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to optimize signal detection in non-Gaussian environments, the work is addressed to provide realistic modeling of a generic noise probability density. The model depends on few parameters which can be estimated quickly and easily, and so general to be able to describe many kinds of noise such as symmetric or asymmetric. To this end, a new model is introduced, which derives from the generalized Gaussian function, and depends on there parameters: kurtosis, for representing variable sharpness, left variance and right variance, for describing deviation from symmetry. The model is applied in the design of a locally optimum detection test.

articleTitle: Web Services Asynchronous Transaction Model Based on JMS
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The transactions in SOA running across multiple services over multiple domains, which will be alive for minutes, hours, even days depending upon the underlying business requirements and implementation, and they used synchronous mechanism to maintain business integrity. Application's performance is seriously hampered because of locking up resources for a long time which is caused by synchronous interaction. This paper proposes Web services asynchronous transaction model based on JMS technology solve long-running transaction problem.

articleTitle: A Novel MIR System Based on Improved Melody Contour Definition
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a method of retrieval a music information by a voice or whistling clip. The method is based on the content of the music file. Firstly, extract the pitch as a kind of musical feature form the digital clip file, and then fix and smooth the discrete data. Bring forward a novel melody contour representation method to depict the musical feature properly. At last, adopt an improved LCS algorithm to matching the feature strings stored in the database. The proposed retrieval method is experimentally evaluated. The evaluation result shows that the improved method could retrieval the object more accurate.

articleTitle: Simulation Architecture of Complex Fluid and Mechanical System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Fluid and mechanical system is becoming much more integrated. It's difficult to simulate the whole system using traditional modeling method concentrates on establishment of several equations. Object-oriented simulation architecture of complex fluid and mechanical system was investigated. An example based the architecture focusing on the hydro-mechanical control system of the turbofan engine was established and the correctness of the model was verified. Simulation processes indicate this method reduces the difficulty of modeling significantly and the architecture has good reusability and expansibility.

articleTitle: A Novel Operation Profit-Driven Admission Control Mechanism for Wireless Multimedia Service Delivery
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless multimedia services delivery, it becomes essential for telecommunications service providers (SP) to guarantee the users' service quality and at the same time maximize them profit as well. For the different grades of multimedia service income and network resources consumption, this paper put forward a parameter of unit price of bandwidth resource (UPBR). With this parameter and by the guidance of user's quality of experience (QoE), services in the wireless network can be upgraded and downgraded by the relevant reasonable admission control (AC) mechanism to achieve the ultimate objective of SP's profit and service quality.

articleTitle: A New C2C-PAKE Protocol in Cross-Realm Setting
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Most existing cross-realm client-to-client (C2C) key exchange protocols are based on password authentication, which are vulnerable to password guessing attacks. Sun et al. and Lee et al. have proposed three-party key exchange protocols respectively, which achieve higher security through verifier authentication instead of password authentication. However, their key exchange protocols can only be used in single-server C2C setting. In this paper, we propose a new cross-realm C2C-PAKE protocol, which is based on verifier authentication, and enable two clients to agree on a common session key with assistance of two servers in different realms. The protocol is shown to be resistant against various attacks including password guessing attacks and server compromise attack.

articleTitle: Method of Image Retrieval Based on Annular Isometric Division and Color Histogram
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Based on color histogram, a new search method is presented in this paper. Firstly, quantify the image in HSV space and split it into annular isometric region. Calculate the third-order moment as feature vectors and realize image retrieval by the similarity comparing between the images. Experimental results show that this improved approach is better than the simple use of color histogram in an accurate survey.

articleTitle: Sharing Mechanism of Educational Resource System Based on Grid
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Because of the heterogeneity of Internet (both of the software and hardware), the education resources cannot be shared sufficiently, and lots of them are redeveloped. Applying grid technology to education field will greatly improve the conditions of distant learning. There are three levels in structure of grid-based educational resource system: Hardware and the resource database, grid server system and users' portal. The foundation of grid-based educational resource sharing system is metadata, resource finding mechanism and resource collecting and publishing mechanism.

articleTitle: Making Match Tradeoff System Based on Multi-agent in Mobile E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Increasing mobile terminals have been promoting the development of mobile electronic commerce greatly. Researches on making match tradeoff system are very useful to improve the intelligence and autonomy of mobile electronic commerce platforms. Before a design scheme of mobile electronic commerce making match tradeoff system with multi-agent supported, WAP and agent key technologies were introduced.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Video Transmission System Based on Binding Multiple NICs
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper designs a video transmission system based on binding multiple NICs, considering the situation and the problems of streaming media transmission. With the binding multiple NICs, RTP load optimizing strategy and the special distribution strategy of RTP packet data, the problem of congestion due to the network bandwidth deficiency under large concurrency situation can be effectively solved. The results of experiment have proved that the system reduces the loss rate of packet and improves transmission efficiency in large concurrency-visiting network.

articleTitle: The Application of Multimedia in Academic Library
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper has presented the multimedia application framework in academic libraries. Three application layers were discussed in this article: library marketing, library services and library resources. The reason of library marketing was analyzed and library marketing methods were given in this article. Multimedia applications in library services and the main type of multimedia resource in academic libraries were analyzed in this paper too. A survey on multimedia services in academic libraries was given at last.

articleTitle: Research on Merger and Acquisition Reorganization Patterns of Textile Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: After more than 20 years development, merger and acquisition has become more and more popular and gradually becomes the main tool for enterprises to adjust the industrial structure and optimize the allocation of resources. M&A has three patterns: vertical, horizontal and mixed. Enterprises should consider the effect of internal and external environment and related constraints in choosing M&A patterns. This paper lists related factors that influence the M&A patterns, analyzes their influences and offers advices in choosing M&A patterns with current industrial conditions in mind.

articleTitle: A Method of Multimedia Software Reliability Test Based on Software Partial Quality Measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: According to the characteristics of multimedia software this paper presents an approach about how to use the software partial quality measurement and reliability prediction to adjust the test allocation of software reliability test which is based on the original operational profile. In this new approach, software reliability test is not only based on the operational profile but also guided by the prediction result of software partial quality measurement. The adjustable range is decided by the operation independence factor which can be gotten by neural network learning algorithm and is different from software to software.

articleTitle: The Application of  PSC-CEA in the Process of Resource Allocation Dynamic Policy Triggering during the Switchover of Mobile IP
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper demonstrates the necessity of the use of PSC-CEA for dynamic policy triggering in the process of mobile IP switching; in the mean time, according to the characteristics of policy based network management, propose a dynamic policy trigger model, and designs a mechanism which is used to update dynamic policy according to known information, experience and knowledge to satisfy the QoS of mobile services and use current network resource sufficiently.

articleTitle: Research on the Promotion of Web-Based Autonomous Learning by Multiple Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Developing learner autonomy has been one of goals for teaching. In the new teaching mode which is backed up by on-line techniques, Web-based learner autonomy and its development are essential to learners. The traditional evaluation - summative evaluation only attends to the grades and results in neglecting the learning process and thus can't encourage learners to learn autonomously. This paper discusses multiple evaluation and its influence on the learners' Web-based autonomous learning. The authors have made an investigation before using multiple evaluation in the teaching. Then the authors and their colleagues perform multiple evaluation in the experimental classes while only traditional evaluation in the control classes. This situation lasts a school year, and then another investigation is carried out. The analysis of the results of the investigation shows that multiple evaluation can greatly improve learners' on-line autonomous learning ability. The results demonstrate the need to carry out the multiple evaluation in the new Web-based learning setting.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Centers Location Problem
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The distribution center (DC) is an important component of modern logistics, like a bridge that connects the suppliers and customers, and its location problem has been attached importance very much. In this paper, the existing DC location model is expanded by considering the situation with multi-suppliers. Meanwhile, this location problem is divided into the supply stage and the distribution stage, and then we use the max-min ant clustering algorithm at these stages respectively to optimize the complete location problem. Finally, a simulation experiment is given to verify the feasibility of this algorithm, and the results indicate that this algorithm is suitable for the DC location with the existence of multi-suppliers.

articleTitle: A Novel Logic Analysis Method with AI-Fuzzy VCR
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Logic Analysis Method (LAM) always was realized with some n-Figures binary numbers, its FM (Figures' Module) is the lowest in all FCN (Fixed Carrying Numbers), and all FCN are ones of special VCN (Variable Carrying Numbers). All Numbers' Value of VCN is very fuzzy, because their VCR (Variable Carrying Rules) may be designed in Artificial Intelligence (AI). FPGA is a new material Programmable Logic Units in end of the 20th century, it was with some properties such that, large memory of capacities, short delays of time, improvement able & flexibilities etc. On the basis theory of Neural Fuzzy System of Networks (NFSN), this paper gives a novel logic analysis method with AI-Fuzzy VCR. The dynamic logic analysis algorithm takes a reusing technique of VCR path, a process of middle-data to be shaped & placed in RAM. In the deep research & analysis of logic testing, this analysis method is still practicable.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of Linux Intrusion Detection System Based on Network Protocol Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The architecture of network intrusion detection system based on network protocol analysis on Linux is provided. The design methods and realization technology of every module are discussed and implemented. The network intrusion detection theory and the IRDL (intrusion rules description language) based on the network protocol analysis is studied in detail.

articleTitle: Fast Motion Estimation for Real Time H.264 Video Encoder
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The H.264 video coding standard has achieved a significant improvement in coding efficiency over previous standards. However, the computational complexity of the H.264 encoder is increased drastically, which results in implementation for the real time applications practically difficult. Motion estimation is one of the modules in H.264 video encoder that requires significant amount of computation, which occupies up to 70% of total encoding time. This paper presents an effective scheme to reduce the computational complexity of motion estimation to meet real time requirements. The scheme adopts a fast method to predict the initial center of search windows and perform the motion vector search in a halfway stop way, which reduce the computational complexity of motion estimation by exploiting the statistical characteristic of motion vector. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme improves the performance of the H.264 encoder greatly in terms of encoding speed.

articleTitle: The Research of Application of Video Resources in Web-Based Course
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Video resources are the recurrence of teaching scene and the active screen of web-based course, so they not only enrich expression forms of Web-based course but also deduce concrete processes or emotions that are difficult to describe with simple words. In the paper, the concept and classify of video is described and significance of video applied in Web-based course is discussed. By analyzing the problems of video resources themselves and their applications in Web-based course, some advice to prompt the quality of them is brought forward.

articleTitle: System of Synchronous Averaging De-noising Based on Labview
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to detect the weak signal contaminated by strong background noise, and simultaneously reduce the cost of hardware system, an effective de-noising system based on Labview software platform is established. In this paper, we designed synchronous averaging algorithm-based virtual instrument programs using to implement de-noising efficiently, and extract signal successfully, which has been verified by experiment. The data is sampled by the data-acquisition card PCI 5112 made by National Instruments, and processed by the system. Using this technique, we got the signal well, and reduced background noise obviously.

articleTitle: The Role of Intranet in Enterprise Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Firstly, this paper introduces the role of the Internet,extranet and intranet in the knowledge management based on knowledge network analysis. The intranet is the foundation of the knowledge-based corporate in enterprise knowledge management. Then in view of this, it carries out a detailed statement of intranet network technology in the framework map and the role in enterprise knowledge management in order to show the establishment of intranet is the basic request of knowledge management.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Networks Optimized by Genetic Algorithm in Forecasting Electric Field Aging Technics
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In the study, back-propagation neural networks (BP-NN) theory and genetic algorithm(GA) were used to build a nonlinear prediction model reflecting the relationship between technics parameters of electric field aging and mechanical properties of LY12 aluminum alloy. In this model, electric field intensity, aging temperature and time were as input parameters. Tensile strength, yield strength and micro-yield strength were as output parameters. The result shows that BP-NN model has good training ability whose error was less than 0.1%. The maximal error of BP-NN model for forecasting the mechanical properties under selected technics was close to 10%. Using genetic algorithm to optimize BP-NN (GA-BP) can not increase the training ability which had a higher training error in the condition of less experiment datas, but GA-BP model can improve the prediction ability of BP-NN model and the maximal prediction error was less than 4% which lied at rational range. GA-BP model can be used to optimize technics parameters and decrease experimental work and cost which is a new method for studying electric field aging technics.

articleTitle: Study on Regional Logistics Information Platform Based on Multi-media Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Development of Regional logistics information platform is a complicated system. Based on requirements analysis, a regional logistics information platform is developed in the paper. In order to process the various media information during logistics operation, a multi-media database is designed. The platform has a hierarchy structure, and includes such five levels as physical, technical, data, functional, and service. The application of multi-media technology and data mining is a guarantee to make full use of the logistics information platform.

articleTitle: IFN Application in DFS of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Depth-first searches (DFS) were both traditional & classical blind searching technique in artificial intelligence (AI). Variable carrying numbers (VCN) is a broad concept of numbers in number theory. AI-fuzzy VCN (IFN) is a mixture numbers with different figures' module (FM) in a same n-figures number. Fixed carrying numbers (FCN) is only ones of special VCN. This paper makes an analyzing & discussing of DFS technology of both FCN and VCN in searching without information, and points out that, merits and demerits of two Numbers on searching without information. And then, it gives a novel IFN method of DFS in problem solving which sometimes we should think simultaneously over the intelligent properties of VCN, and gives out an example of the problem-solving method, i.e. the problem solving such as catching fish with casting a net.

articleTitle: Bid Evaluation of Electric Equipment Based on VIKOR Method
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Multiple criteria decision modeling is proposed for determining the most preferred bidding markup in a competitive bidding situation. This paper presents a new evaluation approach - VIKOR method - to solve the MCDM (multiple criteria decision making) problems with conflicting criteria or criteria of different units. Since this method provides a maximum "group utility" of the "majority" and a minimum of the individual regret of the "opponent", the obtained compromise solution could be readily accepted by the decision makers. Besides, The coefficients of weight for evaluation factors are obtained from the avail value of data reflecting the information entropy, by which the weight allocation is more reasonable. A numerical example is presented to illustrate the methodological issues in the bid evaluation and the numerical results show that the proposed approach is effective. This method can precisely demonstrate the bidding units' technological and economical characteristic.

articleTitle: Adaptive Turbo-coded Modulation for Progressive Image Transmission on Flat-Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive turbo-coded modulation is used in a joint source and channel coding (JSCC) system on flat-fading channels. Assume perfect channel estimate and instantaneous feedback, the optimal power and rate adaptation strategy is determined to achieve the minimum average distortion for progressive image transmission under the bandwidth and average power constraints. The solution requires high-complexity computer search methods. However, by adopting a discrete-rate scheme and fixing the packet error rate in each channel region, the problem can be simplified into an optimal solution for maximum throughput. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme outperforms conventional nonadaptive JSCC schemes on varying channels.

articleTitle: An Agent Coordination Framework with Quantitative Timing Constraints
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Agent coordination is essential to achieve the goals of tasks acting in a coherent manner. In this paper, we present an agent coordination framework with quantitative timing constraints for time critical multi-agent systems. The framework can be used for automatically detecting if interaction behaviors among agents are timing consistent w.r.t given tasks. All timing consistency detections can be resolved by simple linear programming.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis on Green Risk Information of Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Construction project green risks (CPGRs) refer to those threats to environment, energy sources and material resources during the entire life-cycle of a construction project. The emergent green risks in exploiting these resources are of varying concern to all. In this paper, evolutionary game is introduced to make about impacts of strategy choices from interactions among the choices developers, and between the choices developers and EPDs on project green risk. The results show that CPGRs will occur if either developers find that not managing CPGRs has a better payoff than opting for CPGR management, or if monitors impose only mild fines even when they find CPGRs within construction projects of developer's firms. The study also shows that there is a prohibitively expensive cost incurred by EPDs in monitoring CPGRs. Finally, some strategies are given for EPDs to help them make policies to regulate the strategies of developers.

articleTitle: The Ring Data Structure Implemented with Java and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper first introduces the ring data structure and its main characteristics such as capacity, head and tail, then analyzes how to implement the new data structure and the key operations of isFull and isEmpty with Java programming. The paper lists out further the most important codes of the main algorithms of the ring data structure, finally employs the ring data structure to a application of words counting and shows the result.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Semantic Query Based on Distribute Ontologies
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we presented an approach for semantic information query based on semantic approximation, where a ranking strategy for answering results is also proposed. We also exploited the implementation technologies related to the approach. Furthermore, a distributed semantic query system called DSQ and experimental results are developed.

articleTitle: Follow-Up Survey of  Autonomy in "Zero-Approach" Teaching Mode Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: "Zero-approach" Teaching mode is an effective one for improvement of autonomy of students, esp. for students of second-level College. In the "zero-approach" teaching mode, the course has been set up, but the teacher does not have to teach as usual because there is no time allocated for formal classroom teaching. The role of the teacher is to assign learning materials for students, sometimes they arrange learning tempo, direct learning course, supply students with learning methods, monitor the whole learning process, and evaluate "zero-approach" teaching mode scientifically stage by stage. With the changeover of roles of teachers, teaching was regarded as full fulfillment of autonomy of students. The author had made a follow-up survey of "zero-approach" teaching mode about one and half year. And the author have tried her best to find advantages and disadvantages of the mode to reach teaching aims. From the analysis, the author tries to show the necessity of the application of "zero-approach" teaching mode in some courses in second-level college in China.

articleTitle: IPv6 End-to-End QoS Provision in Heterogeneous Networks Using Flow Label
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The next generation Internet Protocol, IPv6, has attracted growing attention and has been deploying worldwide, especially in Europe, Asia, and North America. It intends to provide better QoS (quality of service) ability for the increasing demanding multimedia service, and FL (flowlabel) field in IPv6 main header was designed to be a big help in alleviating QoS problem. However, the related research work is still far from enough to make it practical. In this paper, we firstly investigate FL based cross domain QoS management in heterogeneous networks. The main contribution of this paper is threefold: First, we attempt to provide an analysis of FL-related definitions, and subsequently propose a modified IPv6 FL specification, which from the view of the authors can provide an efficient QoS. Second, we propose a novel FL-based inter-domain QoS solution, together with the detailed mechanism for FL generation, deletion and maintenance. Third, we extend SIP protocol for FL negotiation process. Experiment results show that our FL-based QoS model has better performance than existing ones.

articleTitle: Equivalence between a Boundary Value Problem with Obstacles on the Boundary and a Variational Problem
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Contact problems widely exist in diverse fields. Many contact problems are induced to boundary values and variational problems. Boundary variational inequality methods have been playing crucial roles in contact problems fields, which induce all the boundary conditions and contact conditions to one variational inequality and make the theoretical analysis very easy. Variational problem is a bridge to solve boundary values by variational inequality. In the paper, a function is derived on the base of the functional of potential energy, and their equivalence between a boundary value problem with obstacles on the boundary and equal variational problem is proved. So the partial differential equation's boundary value with obstacles can be solved by the corresponding variational problem.

articleTitle: A Novel FNN Algorithm and Its Application on M&A Performance Evaluation Based on Kirkpatrick Model
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The mergers and acquisitions (M&A) performance measurement is an important tool to test the M&A effects, evaluate the validity of M&A decision-making, and which is an important part in the M&A management. But how to measure the M&A performance is a major issue that troubled many enterprises. This paper overcomes the shortcoming of tradition linear M&A measuring methods, proposes a measuring method which establishes a performance evaluation system combined with Kirkpatrick model and describes the evaluation mechanism based on fuzzy algorithm and BP neural network. The performance evaluation of 10 enterprises in Baoding City shows that the results given by this model are reliable, and this method to evaluate the M&A performance is feasible.

articleTitle: Component Model Research for MES-Oriented Human Resources Management System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Software reuse is an effective way to improve the efficiency of software development and the quality of software product. Software component reuse is the main form of it. This paper studies a component-based software development method and development model, establishes a human resources management system (HRMS) component structure model and Manufacturing Execution System (MES)-oriented multilayer HRMS, resolves the problems of redundancy and low efficiency in the HRMS code development process.

articleTitle: Cymbal-Type Receiver Produced with PLZT Ceramic
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, a practical design and fabrication of a small receiver which combines the structure of cymbal-type receiver with the material of a new kind of piezoelectric ceramic PLZT (lanthanum-modified lead zirconate titanite ) was introduced. The working principle of which was studied, and the characteristics such as frequency response, sensitivity and directivity were investigated. Finite element method (FEM) is used for frequency response and sensitivity analysis. Two kinds of prototype of cymbal-type receiver had been made and calibrated, Experimental results show that the receivers made by PLZT have lower sensitivity but more stable reception property in comparison with those made by lead zirconate titanite (PZT).

articleTitle: Study on the Specific ncRNAs Based on Z-curve Method
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Because of non-coding sequences playing more and more important roles in the process of translation, it has very important significance to research non-coding region and its function. In the recent years, the researches have been made great progress on the non-coding regions, especially about non-protein-coding RNA (ncRNAs). The Z curve is a very useful method for visualizing and analyzing DNA sequences. It is a three-dimensional space curve constituting the unique representation of a given DNA sequence in the sense that each can be uniquely reconstructed from the other. Based on the Z curve, this paper picks up 20 Specific ncRNAs (BC200 RNA and BC1 RNA) sequences from the NONCODE database, which relate with disease-cancer and come from different organisms. The corresponding Z curves of the ncRNAs sequences have been mapped and compared. The geometrical features of the studied ncRNA sequences are obtained. These features indicate the ncRNA sequences having same functions have almost same Z-curve shapes or tendency and base content in spite of difference of organisms.

articleTitle: IDMA/CDMA: A Hybrid Multiple Access Scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid multiple access scheme which combines interleave division multiple access (IDMA) and code division multiple access (CDMA), therefore, we refer to this scheme as IDMA/CDMA. We employ IDMA technique as the uplink transmission and CDMA technique as the downlink transmission. Thus, IDMA/CDMA can achieve a very simple chip-by-chip iterative multi-user detection (MUD) strategy at the base station, and the simplified receive processing for the user ends (UEs). The proposed scheme can substantially utilize the advantages of IDMA and CDMA technologies.

articleTitle: Contourlet-Based Tree Approximation and Encoding
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: A new tree approximation based on contourlet transform is proposed in this paper. Contourlet transform produce a simple and effective representation frame for geometrical image by employing Laplace-pyramid decomposition and followed by direction filter bank (DFB). However, the redundancy of contourlet constrains its application in image representation. Fortunately, as one of many nonlinear approximation methods, tree structure poses an economical encoding method for images. Because of the refinement of tree structure for nonlinear approximation, a tree structure encoding method for image based on contourlet transform is also introduced. Experiments show that contourlet-based tree approximation outperforms wavelet-based tree approximation.

articleTitle: Improving Contour Tracker through Evolutionary Optimization
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Tracking contours in an image sequence is a challenging task. Tracking algorithms based on particle filter have been proposed for this nonlinear problem. But, contour trackers often collapse due to the sample impoverishment of the traditional particle filter. In this paper, we integrate evolutionary optimization into particle filter, and it is applied to visual contour tracking. The impoverishment problem can be prevented using crossover and mutation operation. Moreover, the re-sampling process is replaced by selection operation. Particles can be redistributed to the local modes with the evolution of the particle population. Experimental results on some recorded videos demonstrate the proposed tracker has the better performance for the changed contour and the clutter.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Telemedicine System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Telemedicine system has become as a major research topic due to the increase of aging population and chronic diseases. Patients usually transfer their test results to the hospitals or doctors through telemedicine system. The purpose of this report is to combine the current medical equipments and services with and the most recent network technology. Through telemedicine system, patients will have more comprehensive medical care and can access test results from their home. Doctors can conduct remote prescriptions to the patients after conducting remote on line monitoring and checking on their patients.

articleTitle: Optimization of Response Performance in Graphics Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: With the development of network technology, image-based real-time monitoring system has become a hot topic in the area of industrial automation, but in the current real-time system, the large volume of data transmission and the frequent interaction between client and server become the bottlenecks of real-time system. For these problems, the paper analyzed the concept of SVG which is XML-based, and using advance compression technology to compress SVG files, which reduced the volume of data transmission. Besides, the paper present a new data acquisition mode which combines push and Ajax, experiment results show that proposed mode reduced the frequent interaction between client and server, enhanced the efficiency of transmission of real-time information.

articleTitle: Study on SDT-SVM Inversion Control Technique
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a SVM implementation based on simplified decision trees (SDT). SDT-SVM applies SDT to the calculation of sector index and the duration of the adjacent switching state vectors, by which the none-linear calculations such as sin, atan and sqrt functions are avoided. This technique can be realized easily and reduces the computation time and improves the accuracy markedly. Further more, the sample time can be shortened in this case, which can reduce the total harmonic distortion (THD) and make the output waveform better.

articleTitle: The Application of Multimedia and Instant Messaging Technology in Distance Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In the video and audio chatting system, the transmission control of media stream is one of the most important issues. This paper introduces system solutions and design of key technologies, including the DirectShow framework of real-time audio and video exchanging, combined with MPEG-4 audio and video coding technology. We streamline the RTP protocol to achieve a good audio and video data analysis and packaging strategy, and we also use RTCP protocol to provide relevant information which can be used to adjust the sending rate of network so that the system will meet the user to the quality of communication.

articleTitle: A Model for Fleet Assignment in the City-Pair Route Network
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The fleet assignment is an important factor affecting the airline's operation costs. Given a flight schedule, which consisted of a set of flights with specified departure and arrival time, a set of aircraft types and a set of restrictions, the airline fleet assignment problem (FAP) is to determined which aircraft type should fly each flight leg. Based on the analysis of the real operation circumstance and the technical parameter of different kinds of aircraft types, a mathematical model for the city-pair network and the corresponding solution are offered in this paper. It is practical for an airline which operates between two branch airports.

articleTitle: An Effective Particle Filter Tracking Varying Numbers of Multi-object
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In the paper, we proposed an approach based on Bayesian framework to track varying number of objects using fixed camera. The approach is performed at both detection level and tracking level. At the detection level, a background-building algorithm is used to extract the spatial and color distribution of objects in a complex circumstance. At the tracking level, we used particle filter to track and label objects; to analyze the occurrences and probabilities of events such as continuation, birth and death, we update the correspondence matrix by matching features of object. We experiment the proposed approach on cars in highway video sequences, and verify the effectiveness and reliability of the method.

articleTitle: Objective Quality Metric Based on Spatial-Temporal Distortion
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Digital video has pervaded the lives of people due to the popularity of applications. In this paper, we propose novel objective quality metrics for video sequences. This metrics are capable of capturing spatial distortions in video sequences, in addition to temporal artifacts. And they can quantify the spatial distortions and differentiate the type of distortion. Furthermore the metrics correlate well with the subjective quality measures because perception distortions of human have been taken into consideration. Experimental results show that our perceptual quality metrics performs better than the existing methods.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Method for Multi Processor Scheduling Using Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: One of the key important issues in project management is trade off between cost and time in such a way that the project is completed in the shortest time and minimum cost. Genetic algorithm is a practical approach for such optimization problems. In this paper, an algorithm is presented to solve the time-cost tradeoff problem (TCTP) using genetic algorithm. In this algorithm in order to search the problem space two control variables are used. Also an intelligent mutation operator is presented to approximate to the projectpsilas optimal point. Comparing this algorithm with Siemens classical algorithm shows the higher speed of proposed algorithm because in this algorithm many computations of paths in project's network graph are not needed.

articleTitle: Study on the Performances of Trellis Dirty Paper Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Trellis dirty paper watermarking is an implement of watermarking with side information, which has very good performances. But the structure issue remains unclear, and how to choose a proper structure and reference pattern in terms of all the performance indexes is still a problem. In this paper, the performance indexes of the trellis dirty paper watermarking and its factors that affect the performances are introduced, and the effect of trellis structure and reference pattern on fidelity, robustness and complexity are tested and analyzed. Experimental results provide a better understanding of the trellis dirty paper watermarking, it shows that different trellis structure and reference pattern have great effect on the performances, but in most situations, the 64 times 64 trellis can get a better tradeoff among fidelity, robustness and complexity. Besides, choosing the reference pattern which has the more similar distribution with the cover work can get a lower bit error ratio.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring Alarm Technology Based on Moving Object Detecting
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Intelligent video monitoring is a new technology originally developed on the basis of video image processing technology. Aiming at the defects of monitoring conducted by man in the conventional practice, the automatic alarming technology based on intelligent video monitoring was studied. Frame difference-based dynamic background refreshing algorithm was applied to monitored scenes to carry out cutting and information extraction of moving object as well as complete anomaly judgement. Moreover, anomaly information and key moving object tracking image sequences can be recorded in real time at the monitor client. By doing so, automatic anti-theft alarm was realized and the goal of safety protection was achieved. The results of experiment show that the intelligent video monitoring technology has favorable performance. It enhances the monitoring level and effects, and really achieves automatic monitoring alarm by tracking moving object in video.

articleTitle: The Study on Double-Element Control Mechanism of Academic Quality of Sci-Tech Papers Published via Internet
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: New Internet applications are coming out at an unprecedented rate under the rapid development of Internet technologies, and the network platform of sci-tech papers published is exactly a result of the information technical development. This paper introduce a method of double-element which includes rigid mechanism-process control and soft mechanism-incentive and constraint mechanism to study the academic quality control of sci-tech papers published under network environment.

articleTitle: The Study of the Bluetooth Circular Path
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: The purpose of this paper is a study under the Piconet of Bluetooth, We analyze for the packet transmission path, the packet delay or loss. Find solutions related to the corresponding methods to increase the efficiency of data transmission. Hence improve the overall stability of the Bluetooth network's transmission.

articleTitle: A Wideband One-Ring MIMO Reference Channel Model for Non-isotropic Scattering Environments
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, we propose a wideband one-ring multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) reference channel model for non-isotropic scattering environments. The model is designed in such a way that the delay power spectral density (PSD) of the reference channel model is identical to a given delay PSD. Furthermore, closed-form solutions are provided for the temporal autocorrelation function (ACF), the two-dimensional (2-D) space cross-correlation function, and the frequency correlation function (FCF). Finally, numerical results are presented for the reference channel model. The proposed reference channel model is an important framework for the derivation of an efficient wideband MIMO channel simulator with given space-time-frequency correlation properties.

articleTitle: The Application and Design of Second Order EKF Based on GPS/DR Integration for Land Vehicle Navigation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a land vehicle navigation algorithm based on the Global Positioning System (GPS) and the dead reckoning (DR).To achieve high location and velocity accuracy, second order extended Kalman filter (SEKF) is introduced for GPS/DR integrated navigation system. And the algorithm of the first extended Kalman filter (FEKF) and the second EKF (SEKF) are given. Further, the state models and measurement models of GPS/DR are set up. For comparision purpose, the algorithm performance of FEKF and SEKF is contrasted. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed SEKF algorithm gives much higher navigation accuracy than FEKF algorithm for land vehicle navigation. The algorithm has obvious advantages of high accuracy.

articleTitle: The News Extracting System Based on S-K Filtering Mode
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Internet has brought about the problem of "information overload". How to liberate the journalists from the heavy network news filtering works is a significant challenge. In this paper a new information filtering method based on S-K (social learning and knowledge base) model is brought forward through the research of the existing information filtering technology. This approach can lead the users to study the Web media they are interested with (social learning), and then care for their own demands (user knowledge base). Finally, the S-K filtering model and the concrete realization of the news extracting system are presented.

articleTitle: Study on the Visual Navigation of Transporting Girder Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Transporting girder vehicle moving mainly rely on manual operation, which can not be achieved automatically driving. In order to achieve automatic drive, a method based on image processing is suggested. A wavelet-based image coding technique which can compresses the navigation image and improves the real-time performance of the system is used, and the wavelet edge detection algorithm is applied to navigation image edge accurate positioning. Image edge is straightened by Hough transform. Results showed that the method is simple and effective.

articleTitle: An Improved Using P2P Streaming Media Technology in Distance Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the network congestion bottleneck in traditional distance learning system, this paper proposed a P2P streaming media technology based on the multimedia teaching platform solutions. In this method, teachers' node was set as the media source, and multicast tree was adopted to transmit teaching video. Dynamic feedback load balancing algorithm was used to optimize node selection mechanism and maintain the balance of multicast trees.

articleTitle: Study of Application of Network Simulator to Comparing Performances of Network Protocols
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Network simulator (NS) is a kind of enwlation software with powerful functions. Its biggest function is that it can check and compare the performances of various kinds of protocols and provide experimental data for researchers to analyse whether their performances are good or bad. This paper proposes a method to design network topology and script program, then uses NS to compare performances of network protocols.

articleTitle: The Application of Web-Based Public Participation Geographic Information Systems for Protection of the Famous Historical and Cultural Cities in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper is to discuss the application of web-based public participation geographic information systems (PPGIS) for protection of the famous historical and cultural cities in China. According to the characteristics of public participation and geographic information systems (GIS), the paper presents an application framework of PPGIS, and divides the application of PPGIS in China into three levels, ranging from simple demonstrations through to more complex spatial decision support systems. The publics at different levels of PPGIS application play different roles during the period of participating in protection of the famous historical and cultural cities. The technologically advanced PPGIS can usually provide users with more functions to analyze the data from all participants, including the publics, experts and decision-makers, but the level of its application depends not only on the level of PPGIS technology, but also on project conditions. Organizations should develop an appropriate PPGIS for a project in the light of different circumstances.

articleTitle: The Research of Distributed Parallel System Based on Video Compression
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Distributed parallel system provides a very good way of using idle resource of every computer effectively. For such idea of saving resource, the thesis designs and realizes a distributed parallel system based on video compression. Video compression is a complex computing process, using idle resources to serve for such problem is significant. In the actual realization, taking the correctness of final result, the unique characteristics of distributed parallel system and the instability of network into consideration, the system appends the bit-stream integration mechanism, the state inspection mechanism and the fault tolerance mechanism. In conclusion, this system has the characteristics of usability, extendibility, self-adaptive and fault-tolerance. At last, from the experiment results, we can find that the system can greatly shorten the compressing time, and considerably speed up the compressing process. It is an effective solution to complex problem of video compression or other research fields.

articleTitle: Research on Multimedia Technology and Applications in Network
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on MultiMedia and Information Technology
abstract: Nowadays, multimedia technology is widely applied in everywhere. With increasing availability of spatial data, there is an urgent need to develop way and means for providing easy accessibility and promote spatial data sharing. In this paper, we analyze the multimedia application, discuss the multimedia technology in video and audio. Multimedia system offers operators the opportunity to build an open IP based service infrastructure that will enable an easy deployment of new rich multimedia communication services mixing telecom and data services.
